title: BEARING
alt_text: A fine gold chain drags through a crack in dark stone. In a vaulted stone chamber lit by one brass lantern, the chain lies in a loop on a long table, then is pulled taut across the crack and snaps, its halves whipping apart. A brown hand picks up the broken end and draws it away. The broken chain rests on the table and the word BEARING appears in white.

location.name: Royal Observatory Greenwich
location.why: Home of the Prime Meridian: the line the world takes its bearings from. Name your own reference point.

youtube.description:
You can still repeat what they said. Word for word.

Now name one thing you did right by yourself.

Sometimes the person who hurt you breaks a pattern you hadn't. Don't mistake that for a favor.

They don't get credit for where you turn. You do.
